title: Pairwise AUC Optimization Needs Corrective Power: A Unified View
abstract: arXiv:2610.21743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance. This creates a direct alignment between the training objective and the evaluation metric, but such metric alignment alone does not guarantee that stochastic training remains corrective. We study this gap through Corrective Power: whether pairwise mini-batch updates produce stronger and more reliable improvements for more severe positive-negative ranking errors. Our main observation is that direct pairwise training can enter regions where severe errors remain common but no longer produce useful corrective motion. In such regions, even the mini-batch noise that would normally help SGD move along the steepest severe-error correction direction can become much weaker. translated_title: 成对AUC优化需要纠错能力：一个统一的视角
translated_abstract: 直接成对AUC代理训练之所以具有吸引力，是因为它朝着测试时所使用的排序指标进行优化，在类别不平衡场景下尤其如此。这在训练目标与评估指标之间建立了直接的对齐关系，但仅凭这种指标对齐并不能保证随机训练始终具有纠错性。我们通过“纠错能力”来研究这一差距：即成对小批量更新能否为更严重的正负样本排序错误带来更强、更可靠的改进。我们的主要观察是，直接成对训练可能会进入某些区域，在这些区域中严重错误依然普遍存在，但训练不再产生有效的纠错运动。在这样的区域中，即使是通常能够帮助SGD沿着最陡峭的严重错误纠正方向移动的小批量噪声，也会变得弱得多。本文通过探索由此形成的U-统计量的退化性质，为这一现象寻求理论解释。
tldr: 本文发现直接成对AUC训练可能进入严重排序错误频发但丧失纠错能力的退化区域，并通过U-统计量的退化性质为该现象提供了统一的理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that direct pairwise AUC training can enter degenerate regions where severe ranking errors remain common but lose corrective power, and provides a unified theoretical explanation through the degeneracy property of U-statistics.
